subject: general
question: The income of Raman is ₹49,000. He saves 27.5% of his income. If his income increases by 34% and expenditure increases by 20%, then his savings will:4744
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income = 100%, Savings = 27.5%, Expenditure = 72.5%.

ΔSavings = ΔIncome − ΔExpenditure

ΔIncome = 34% of 100 = 34 units

ΔExpenditure = 20% of 72.5 = 14.5 units

ΔSavings = 34 − 14.5 = 19.5 units

Actual Increase = 19.5% of 49,000 = 19.5 × 490 = ₹9,555.

**∴ The correct answer is increase by ₹9,555.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Income = ₹49,000 | Savings % = 27.5% | Income Increase = 34% | Expenditure Increase = 20%

Formula: Income = Expenditure + Savings

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f3ec5cc57559950a88b020e3a9578ee3546f9ab3fa425cbec9cc81940ff8230.png] 

⇒ Initial Savings = 27.5% of 49,000

⇒ Initial Savings = (27.5 ÷ 100) × 49,000 = 13,475

⇒ Initial Expenditure = 49,000 − 13,475 = 35,525

⇒ Increase in Income = 34% of 49,000 = 0.34 × 49,000 = 16,660

⇒ Increase in Expenditure = 20% of 35,525 = 0.20 × 35,525 = 7,105

⇒ Increase in Savings = Increase in Income − Increase in Expenditure

⇒ Increase in Savings = 16,660 − 7,105 = 9,555

**∴ The correct answer is increase by ₹9,555.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Identity

Income is always the sum of Expenditure and Savings (I = E + S). Any change in Income must be balanced by the sum of changes in Expenditure and Savings.

Percentage Change in Components

If Income increases by x% and Expenditure increases by y%, the percentage change in Savings is given by (I×x − E×y)/S.

Effective Savings Ratio

When the income is very large, using ratios of savings to expenditure (e.g., 27.5 : 72.5 → 11 : 29) simplifies calculations significantly.
